source_inventory_scope: Inventories were assembled after capture from archived two implementation files plus unchanged common sources, as recorded by root; not claimed written during compilation.
method: Three serial cohorts: wide-tree A, partial-tree B, wide-tree A recheck; identical private v2 executable and common loaded dependencies, separate captured bridge DLLs.
Captured BR1 Tile IR, typed inputs, FP64 reference/bounds and complete manifests are identical. Only IR analysis wall time is ignored.
Explicit fast math, T128/P2/lane8/cachefalse/unroll8 and full numerical bounds are fixed. Only the two authorized bridge implementation files differ.

Requested unroll8 equals the actual emitted GroupPlan field; all 100 graph nodes, CUDA function/module, binding permutation, geometry and final typed pointers are checked. Host bridge export address and complete module lists independently bind the intended A/B DLL.
Original numerical/finite/guard/readonly receipts and full saved-output checks are required independently of speed.
Driver registers/shared/local/max-threads are compiled attributes, not measured occupancy, traffic or causes of performance.
All seven raw samples and negative results are retained. No fitting, trimming, speed-based admission or historical timing denominator.
No Torch measurement or ratio is present. An improvement here alone does not establish superiority to native Tile or Torch.

Bridge source inventories were assembled after capture from archived implementation files and unchanged common sources, not claimed recorded during compilation. Each DLL retains its own real build receipt.
telemetry_scope: Whole-stage telemetry includes compilation, upload, warmup and measurement; no causal attribution.
